remainingBlocker: A stale selection request can reach the selection path without an explicit equality check between request.projectVersion and the trusted current durable project version.
revisedRootCause: Revision 1 correctly moved Design state to durable repositories and removed process-local authority, but its canonical selection write boundary validated project identity through repository lookup and validated artifact checksums without validating that the command's projectVersion was the current durable FactoryProject.currentVersion. The remaining root cause is an incomplete currentness guard at selectDesignDirection, not a second persistence authority.

canonicalAuthority.currentProjectId: The project row returned by ProjectRepository.getWithVersion(request.projectId); its mapped FactoryProject.projectId is the durable identity.
canonicalAuthority.currentProjectVersion: The mapped FactoryProject.currentVersion returned by ProjectRepository.getWithVersion(request.projectId), backed by the durable project metadata row.
canonicalAuthority.projectMemoryRole: Project Memory remains a synchronized filesystem projection and integrity surface, not a second current-version authority.
canonicalAuthority.currentDesignArtifact: The durable design-directions document loaded by (projectId, projectVersion), with its project identity, version, setId, and checksum validated at selection.
canonicalAuthority.selectedDesign: The durable selected-design document written through DesignRepository.select after currentness and artifact validation.
canonicalAuthority.selectionHistory: DecisionRepository append is the durable selection decision/history path; ProjectMemory appendDecision remains the synchronized projection.

selectionCommandContract.requestProjectId: Typed DesignSelectionRequest.projectId identifies the project the caller intends to mutate; it is a lookup key, not an authority source.
selectionCommandContract.requestProjectVersion: Typed DesignSelectionRequest.projectVersion identifies the exact project version against which the caller intends to select; it is untrusted command input and must equal the trusted current FactoryProject.currentVersion.
selectionCommandContract.canonicalInvariant: request.projectId resolves to currentProjectId AND request.projectVersion === currentProjectVersion before selection mutation or successful replay is accepted.
selectionCommandContract.directionIdentity: selectedDirectionId must belong to the durable current direction set identified by request.designDirectionSetId; directionSetChecksum and selectedDirectionChecksum must match the current persisted artifacts.
selectionCommandContract.staleBehavior: Reject closed-loop with existing DesignError code DESIGN_SELECTION_STALE. Do not map the request to the latest version, upgrade its version, retry against the latest version, or continue with current state.

canonicalWriteBoundary.durableMutation: DesignRepository.select followed by Project Memory snapshot, WorkflowPersistenceService.transition, DecisionRepository.append, and Project Memory decision projection.
canonicalWriteBoundary.guardPlacement: Immediately after DesignSelectionRequestSchema.parse and before reading selection replay state or performing any selection-specific work; load ProjectRepository.getWithVersion(request.projectId) and reject absent or mismatched currentVersion.
canonicalWriteBoundary.bypassProtection: The guard belongs in the service mutation boundary, not only in API/UI callers, so resume, admin, direct-service, and future callers receive the same invariant.

forbiddenEffects: write current Design selection to Project Memory
sideEffectPolicy.validReplay: Preserve existing same-version, same-direction idempotent replay after the canonical currentness guard; a stale replay must not be accepted merely because selected-design already exists.
